record.title: microduck-eye-ring — the eye bezel: Pollen Robotics' published mesh `noenoeil` (Ø30.000 × 7.5 mm ring, Ø14.4 bore), mesh-backed part
record.why: GOAL.md finding 1 said the product's eye bezel is missing from the sim meshes; it is this mesh. Against the product photographs (out/head/head.json): front view eye OD / head width 0.3353 vs mesh 0.3226 (+1.16 mm implied on Ø30.000); profiles, scale-free, -0.02 ± 0.32 mm; verdict at the 1.5 mm rule CANNOT DETERMINE. bin/cad part:microduck-eye-ring (2026-09-02): PASS — Solid, valid, 1 shell, 984 faces, volume 4250.219 mm3, bbox 30.000 x 9.500 x 30.000 mm MEASURED off the finished solid.
record.origin_why: the geometry is the vendor's own published sim asset, loaded unchanged (tools/head_eye_ring_shelve.py, 2026-09-03). Not our design; usable to assemble, render, simulate and print; NOT licensed for sale (NC).
